basic_info.description:
Bright and beautifully upgraded, this serene studio is located in the heart of Yerba Buena - one of San Franciscos most vibrant and walkable neighborhoods. Just steps from SF MoMA, Yerba Buena Gardens, and the Moscone Center, the home blends modern luxury with unbeatable urban convenience.
The sleek galley kitchen features granite countertops, a Liebherr refrigerator, and Viking Professional appliances. Recessed under-cabinet lighting adds a clean, contemporary touch. A wall of south-facing windows fills the space with natural light and offers expansive views.

Residents enjoy a peaceful third-floor garden, 24/7 front desk service, secure package room, and on-site management. HOA fees cover water, sewer, garbage, insurance, and common area maintenance. Discounted Crunch Fitness access included. Leased parking available for $360/month.

Neighboring SoMa, Mission Bay, South Beach, and the East Cut, the home is walkable to Trader Joes, Target, Costco, Safeway, and morewith easy access to CalTrain, BART, and Muni.

Some images have been virtually staged to help showcase the intended use and potential of spaces in the home.
